To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for Monday admin meeting — DRAFT, NOT SENT

Renee, here's our rundown for the admin meeting and Dr. Pruitt's board report. Been a good week for this bunch.

We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday and finished second in the region. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week right there in the locker room before the coaches even met. Means something when your teammates see the work you're doing. Defense held Brookhollow to 46 yards rushing in the second half.

Tavion Hurst finished with 188 yards rushing and 2 touchdowns. His long touchdown in the third quarter was a big one, but I want to give that offensive line their due. They pushed them 5 yards back on that whole drive. Best I've seen us block all year.

We've got a HOME playoff game. We host Clanton Valley this Friday, November 13, at 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows, and we'd love for him to encourage folks to come out. Presale tickets start Tuesday. Gate and chain crews need confirming by Wednesday, and boosters still need 6 more people for concessions. Their signup sheet goes out today.

On academics, all 52 kids on the roster are eligible after the nine-week grade check. Nobody on the list. Tonya Greer deserves the credit for that, not me. Her Tuesday and Thursday study halls are paying off, and she's keeping them going through the playoffs.

Boosters sold 208 Boston butts and raised $6,240 against a $4,500 goal. That money goes toward new sideline headsets. Carla and that whole crew did a great job. Hargrove's Meat Market smoked them at cost, and they deserve a thank-you too.

If we win and go on the road, I'll get the bus requests to you with transportation's five-day deadline in mind. I haven't forgotten.
